metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for real software delivery workflows.

plugins.name: delivery-quality
plugins.description: Verification before you trust a change: a verify skill that runs the tests and reads the diff, a read-only review subagent, guards against writing secrets and running destructive commands, and a test gate on session stop.

plugins.name: skill-forge
plugins.description: Write skills that actually fire, and find out why the ones that don't. A scaffolding skill, a mechanical auditor for the faults that stop a skill loading, and a subagent that writes and compares candidate descriptions.

plugins.name: context-discipline
plugins.description: Keep the working state that compaction blurs: a snapshot of the tree taken before compaction and handed back after it, a skill for scoping work before writing it, and an auditor for the CLAUDE.md rules that get ignored.

plugins.name: mcp-builder
plugins.description: Build MCP servers a model can actually use: the right primitive for each capability, tool descriptions that draw the boundary against their neighbours, bounded results, enforced roots, and a transport choice that names what it takes away.

plugins.name: api-patterns
plugins.description: Patterns for building on the Claude API that carry their own verification: an eval pipeline with graders that discriminate, a caching auditor for breakpoints that silently miss, hybrid retrieval fused with RRF, the workflow-or-agent decision, and a reviewer for tool schemas.

plugins.name: team-rollout
plugins.description: Deploy Claude across a team without the expensive mistakes: the five rollout decisions in the order that keeps them from being redone, reference managed and project settings, and a checker for permissions wider than intended, unpinned marketplaces and hooks that never fire.
